name: Castle Restaurant
description: LEGOLAND Billund's most atmospheric dining experience — a beautifully themed medieval castle restaurant in the Knights' Kingdom area serving generous hot and cold buffet lunches and dinners in a spectacular setting decorated with LEGO knights, castle battlements and royal banners. The Castle Restaurant is widely regarded as the best value and most enjoyable dining option in the park — the all-you-can-eat buffet format allows families to satisfy even the hungriest riders without multiple trips to different food outlets.

items.name: Lunch Buffet Adult
items.description: All-you-can-eat hot and cold buffet with soup, main courses and salad bar

items.name: Pizza & Pasta Buffet
items.description: All-you-can-eat pizza and pasta with salad bar

name: Burger Kitchen
description: A popular quick-service burger restaurant located centrally in the park serving freshly made burgers, chicken, fries and soft drinks in a fun LEGO-themed setting. Burger Kitchen is one of the most visited food outlets in the park on busy days — reliably good, centrally located and fast enough to get families back on the rides without a long lunch break. The outdoor seating has pleasant views of the surrounding themed areas.

items.name: Classic Burger
items.description: Beef burger with lettuce, tomato and fries

items.name: Chicken Burger
items.description: Crispy chicken fillet burger with fries

items.name: Kids Meal
items.description: Small burger or nuggets with fries and drink

name: Outpost Burger
description: A fun jungle-themed burger and snack bar in the Adventure Land area — serving burgers, hot dogs, loaded fries and soft drinks in a colourful explorer-themed setting that fits perfectly within the surrounding Adventure Land atmosphere. Outpost Burger is the most convenient food stop for families spending time on the Adventure Land rides and a solid quick-service option for an informal lunch or snack between rides.

items.name: Explorer Burger
items.description: Beef or chicken burger with jungle-themed toppings and fries

items.name: Hot Dog
items.description: Classic Danish hot dog with remoulade and crispy onions

items.name: Loaded Fries
items.description: Crispy fries with cheese sauce and toppings

name: LEGOREDO Saloon
description: A lively Western-themed restaurant in the LEGOREDO Town area serving hearty cowboy-inspired dishes including chicken, ribs, burgers and Danish hot dogs alongside cold beers and soft drinks in a colourful saloon setting complete with country music from The Rattlesnakes — the park's own resident country band who play live throughout the day. The LEGOREDO Saloon is one of the most atmospheric and enjoyable dining stops at LEGOLAND Billund.
